About The School

Shree Vidyanagar Education Trust was established in the year 1953 with a commitment to excellence. Since its inception, the school has striven to provide a holistic learning experience that ensures high standards of academic excellence harmonized by manifold co-curricular activities. During a span of 60 years, we have grown into one of the leading foundation in Ahmedabad providing quality education to our students, facilitated by devoted teachers who are trained to channelize their energy and resources towards child centered qualitative learning. The emphasis is on nurturing students to develop to their full potential.

Shree Vidyanagar School has recently completed glorious journey of 60 years which has incredible record of imparting education. During this long year the institution had drawn much of its inspiration and strength from its founder Shri Himmatbhai Kapasi. The school has distinguished alumni as Doctors, Engineers, accomplished teachers, national level sportsman etc. It has fetched many laurels through hard work and dedication. We still have spirit alive and pretty upbeat to march forward. We had a long cherished dream to start English medium school for young kids and it is indeed with a lot of pride and pleasure that we would like to introduce Shree Vidyanagar English Medium School as esteemed schooling where the ambience is highly creative. The kids enter in new zone which is beautiful circle.

It's truly a moment of pride for Shree Vidyanagar Parivar to introduce"Shree Vidyanagar English Medium School". Infrastructure & Facilities

The school is conveniently located at Usmanpura having campus of 20,000 sq.feet. We have spacious and efficient infrastructure. One of the most luxurious aspects of the building is that they are well-ventilated. High ceilings provide good room for ventilation, while large glass windows help in catching and reflecting sunlight. The building has high compound wall, gate and water connection and other necessary facilities.

Class Rooms:

The classroom size is optimum according to the strength of the class. Cheerful colors, adequate lighting, proper ventilation and careful positioning of study tables contribute to the overall welcoming ambience of the classrooms.

Computer Lab:

In this age of Information Technology, an early exposure to basics of computer prepares every child for the future and also helps the child to overcome any inhibitions they could have towards computer usage. School has a well furnished computer lab with latest models of computers and software.

Science Lab:

The labs are fully furnished with latest technological devices helping students to understand scientific concepts in a practical way through well designed experiments and project work.

Library:

A healthy habit of reading aids to develop the students' intellect above their curriculum .Our library is well equipped to cater to the demands of all the constituents of the school.

Play Area:

School has a multipurpose ground that encourages activities like Volley ball, Football, Badminton and many more. A separate play area with a specific design for children of 3 to 5 years of age group has been provisioned for enabling them to play with various equipments for their recreation.

Achievements

Students of our institution have made a name for themselves in various fields and in turn have earned praise and recognition for our school. The wicket keeper Parthiv Patel of the Indian Cricket Team is a student of our school. Theater personality Saumya Joshi, writer-director of some famous theater plays Paresh Nayak, renowned dancer Smita Shastri and artist Mahendra Kedia have studied in our school.Winners of Gujarat Samachar I.N.T. Drama Competition, Aakash and Ravija are former students of our school. In the field of science, many innovative experiments have been conducted in our school labs and they have been reported in the reputed international journal called FAST of the USA.

Visitors, old and new experience a certain renewed sense of vigour, enthusiasm and freshness on our school premises. Right from the beginning, our management has believed in going beyond the conventional definition of a huge school by encouraging activities that enhance learning process. the renowned Saptak School of Music operates from our school premisses. It is open to music lovers of the city. So is our library to the former students and people interested in literature and general knowledge.

Our school has achieved 100% pass results of the students of X & XII grade in Board examinations given by the Gujarat
      Education Board.

Drawing examinations given by the Central Government Education Board are also taken by the gifted students of our school. Our students have obtained commendable results.

The students have also taken examinations given by "Gandharva Mahavidyalaya Music Academy" and done very well. Similarly our students have actively pursued Sanskrit courses given by Bruhad Gujarat Committee.The students are encouraged to take active part in programmes designed to raise general awareness about atmospheric pollution related issues so that they grow to be responsible adults.Our school has always believed in providing help to the needy children of our school by way of distributing text books, notebooks and offering free academic facilities. when the city was shaken by a massive earthquake in January 2001, our school has made charitable donations to those who were affected.
